description: 白王靠近兵区，驱离黑车后双兵推进

intro.popup_en: White has two connected pawns on the c- and d-files. The black rook is stranded on the back rank; bring the white king closer to lead the attack.
intro.popup: 双兵优势白方双兵在c、d线，黑车孤立在底线，白王需靠近兵区主导局面。

outro.popup_en: White has a clear advantage. The king has approached successfully, and the connected pawns form a powerful advancing force.
outro.popup: 白方明显优势白王成功靠近，双兵形成强大推进力。

moves.popup_en: The white king moves closer to the pawns.
The black king follows, trying to support the rook's defense.
moves.popup: 黑王跟进，试图支援兵区。

moves.popup_en: The white king approaches and controls key squares.
moves.popup: 白王继续逼近，控制关键格。

moves.popup_en: The black king also heads toward the center.
The d-pawn advances. The connected pawns are difficult to defend against together.
moves.popup: d兵挺进！双兵联动，黑方难以同时防守。

moves.popup_en: The black rook attacks from behind and prepares to harass the pawns from the side.
moves.popup: 黑车从后方牵制，准备侧面骚扰。

moves.popup_en: The white king takes the center, supporting both pawns and attacking the black king.
moves.popup: 白王占据中心！王在中心既保护双兵，又进攻黑王。

moves.popup_en: The black rook gives check to harass White and gain time.
moves.popup: 黑车将军骚扰，试图拖延。

moves.popup_en: The white king steps out of check and continues the attack.
moves.popup: 白王躲开将军，继续进攻。
